sentence: It will free up time if students are not required to attend all classes.
translation: 如果不要求所有课都上，就能腾出时间。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：腾出时间
extensions.example: Sharing the housework can free up time for exercise.
extensions.translation: 分担家务可以腾出时间锻炼。

note: 比 save time 更强调“时间被释放出来”。save up 是攒钱物，不接时间。

meaning: 他们省下来的那段时间（接前一句的省时措施）
sentence: Students can use the time they save to study the subjects they are interested in.
translation: 学生可以用省下的时间学自己感兴趣的科目。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：他们省下来的那段时间（接前一句的省时措施）
extensions.example: Employees can use the time they save to learn new skills.
extensions.translation: 员工能用省下的时间学新技能。

note: the time they save 能明确接上前面说的“省下来的时间”。上下文已经清楚时，the time 也可以。

id: 写作-WARMUP-001:the subjects they are interested in
term: the subjects they are interested in
sentence: Students can use the time they save to study the subjects they are interested in.
translation: 学生可以用省下的时间学自己感兴趣的科目。
target: the subjects they are interested in

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：自己感兴趣的科目
extensions.example: Many teenagers prefer to study the subjects they are interested in.
extensions.translation: 很多青少年更愿意学自己感兴趣的科目。

note: 等于 subjects they like；class 是要上的课，科目是 subject。

id: 写作-WARMUP-001:make them more motivated to study
term: make them more motivated to study
sentence: This can make them more motivated to study.
translation: 这能让他们更有动力去学习。
target: make them more motivated to study

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：让他们更有动力学习
extensions.example: Clear goals can make employees more motivated to work.
extensions.translation: 明确的目标能让员工更有动力工作。

note: 用 make + 人 + more motivated to do。换到工作情景，可把 to study 换成 to work。想强调变化，也可用 help them become more motivated。

sentence: Compulsory attendance at every lecture may not be the best approach.
translation: 强制学生参加每一场讲座未必是最好的做法。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：强制出勤
extensions.example: Compulsory attendance is common in secondary schools.
extensions.translation: 强制出勤在中学很常见。

note: 讨论政策时用 compulsory attendance。要补具体活动时，可用 attendance at + 活动。写某人必须出席，可用 be required to attend。

id: 写作-WARMUP-001:may not be the best approach
term: may not be the best approach
sentence: Compulsory attendance at every lecture may not be the best approach.
translation: 强制学生参加每一场讲座未必是最好的做法。
target: may not be the best approach

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：未必是最好的做法
extensions.example: Banning phones in class may not be the best approach.
extensions.translation: 在课堂上禁用手机未必是最好的做法。

note: 比 is not 委婉；attendance 是制度安排，不是 method，说做法用 approach。

meaning: 前一步产生结果，这个结果进而能带来下一步变化（以“这”开头）
sentence: This, in turn, can make them more motivated to study.
translation: 这进而能让他们更有动力去学习。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：前一步产生结果，这个结果进而能带来下一步变化（以“这”开头）
extensions.example: Better sleep improves mood, which, in turn, can raise productivity.
extensions.translation: 睡得好能改善情绪，进而提高效率。

note: This 要指向前一句已经说清的变化。先说措施带来什么，再用 in turn 接这项变化产生的后续结果。

meaning: 花更多时间在某件事上（后接名词）
sentence: College students can spend more time on the subjects they like.
translation: 大学生可以花更多时间学自己喜欢的科目。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：花更多时间在某件事上（后接名词）
extensions.example: Flexible schedules allow parents to spend more time on childcare.
extensions.translation: 灵活的时间安排让父母能花更多时间照顾孩子。

note: 主语是人，用 spend。名词前用 on。要说具体动作，用 spend more time doing sth。

id: 写作-WARMUP-001:required to attend all classes
sentence: In some universities, students are required to attend all classes.
translation: 有些大学要求学生上所有的课。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：被要求上所有的课
extensions.example: All staff are required to attend the training session.
extensions.translation: 所有员工都必须参加这次培训。

note: 写完整句时补上 be。require 表示要求，request 表示请求。class 可指一节课，course 指整门课程，subject 指学科。

sentence: Some students may focus too much on exam scores.
translation: 有些学生可能过于关注考试分数。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：过于关注
extensions.example: Some employees focus too much on small details.
extensions.translation: 有些员工过于关注小细节。

note: too much 表示过度，放在 focus 和 on 之间。

meaning: 前一句提到的行为可能让那群人分心（以“这”开头）
sentence: Some students often look at their phones in class. This may distract them.
translation: 有些学生上课时经常看手机。这可能让他们分心。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：前一句提到的行为可能让那群人分心（以“这”开头）
extensions.example: Some employees work in a noisy room. This may distract them.
extensions.translation: 有些员工在吵闹的房间工作。这可能让他们分心。

note: This 可以承接前面的行为或情景，them 指受到影响的人。

meaning: 赶上规定的截止时间（泛指按时交稿或交付）
sentence: In a part-time job, students may have to deal with customers and meet deadlines.
translation: 做兼职时，学生可能需要和客户打交道，并按时完成任务。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：赶上规定的截止时间（泛指按时交稿或交付）
extensions.example: Working on group projects teaches students how to meet deadlines.
extensions.translation: 做小组项目能教会学生如何按时完成任务。

note: meet a deadline 指赶上某次截止时间。finish their tasks on time 强调任务按时完成。on schedule 强调按原定进度。

meaning: 在工作中和顾客打交道（包括回答问题、处理需求）
sentence: In a part-time job, students may have to deal with customers and meet deadlines.
translation: 做兼职时，学生可能需要和客户打交道，并按时完成任务。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：在工作中和顾客打交道（包括回答问题、处理需求）
extensions.example: Staff learn to deal with customers during their first week at the hotel.
extensions.translation: 员工在酒店上班的第一周学习如何和客户打交道。

note: 陈述工作职责可用 deal with customers。引出具体场景可用 encounter an upset customer，接着写 stay calm and respond politely。

sentence: By taking part-time jobs, students can gain work experience.
translation: 通过做兼职，学生可以获得工作经验。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：获得工作经验
extensions.example: By volunteering, young people can gain work experience.
extensions.translation: 通过做志愿者，年轻人可以获得工作经验。

note: 这里的 experience 表示累积的经验，通常不可数。讲一段具体经历时，可以说 a valuable experience。

sentence: University students often need to manage their time effectively to meet deadlines for their dissertations.
translation: 大学生经常需要合理安排时间，以赶在截止日期前完成论文。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：合理安排时间
extensions.example: Remote workers need to manage their time effectively to stay productive.
extensions.translation: 远程工作者需要合理安排时间以保持高效。

note: 不用 arrange time reasonably（中式搭配）。也可用 manage time well。

meaning: 不一定意味着……（后接一个完整的判断，主语为单数）
sentence: Attendance does not necessarily mean that students learn more.
translation: 出勤不一定意味着学生能学到更多。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：不一定意味着……（后接一个完整的判断，主语为单数）
extensions.example: A higher salary does not necessarily mean that a job is more satisfying.
extensions.translation: 薪水更高不一定意味着工作更令人满意。

note: 用来说明前一件事发生了，也不能据此确定后一件事。后面接 that + 主语 + 谓语。复数主语用 do not necessarily mean。

sentence: Learning new skills can help employees meet employers’ requirements.
translation: 学习新技能可以帮助员工满足雇主的要求。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：满足雇主的要求
extensions.example: Training can help job seekers meet employers’ requirements.
extensions.translation: 培训可以帮助求职者满足雇主的要求。

note: meet employers’ requirements for relevant work experience 表示达到雇主对相关工作经验的要求。把申请人写成主语更清楚，如 Internships can help applicants meet these requirements。

meaning: 进入新工作后适应职场环境
sentence: By developing these practical skills, interns can adapt more quickly to the workplace.
translation: 通过培养这些实践技能，实习生可以更快适应工作环境。
target: adapt more quickly to the workplace

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：进入新工作后适应职场环境
extensions.example: New employees may need time to adapt to the workplace.
extensions.translation: 新员工可能需要时间适应工作环境。

note: adapt more quickly to the workplace 表示更快适应职场。写清怎样做到时，可在前面用 By + 动词-ing，动作由主句主语完成。也可以补结果 spend less time learning tasks from scratch（少花时间从头学）。

sentence: When prices rise, households may need to prioritise essential expenses.
translation: 物价上涨时，家庭可能需要优先安排必要开支。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：优先安排必要开支
extensions.example: Young adults on a tight budget often prioritise essential expenses such as rent and food.
extensions.translation: 预算紧张的年轻人常常优先安排房租和食品等必要开支。

note: prioritise 直接接名词。essential expenses 指必须支付的开支。

sentence: Students can track their spending to stay within their budget.
translation: 学生可以记录开支，把花费控制在预算内。

extensions.meaning: 换语境用：把开支控制在预算内
extensions.example: By comparing ticket prices, travellers can stay within their budget.
extensions.translation: 旅行者可以买票前比价，把开支控制在预算内。

note: within 表示在预算限额以内。主语变化时 their 也相应变化。
